svg.text: One turn through the authority-aware harness
A request from a person in their Home, or from another agent over A2A. Nine steps; three of them verify; one of them signs; one of them proves.
PLANNER — an LLM behind a port
proposes steps · may be wrong, hijacked, or creative
never consulted about whether a step is allowed
AUTHORITY — nothing here consults the planner
THE THREE PLACES A GRANT IS CHECKED — nothing is cached between them except the inputs to the check
The harness reads the delegation, checks the signature against
the delegator's account, checks isRevoked on chain, checks the
caveats cover THIS tool, resource and arguments — compared in
the ontology's vocabulary, not a guess.
A human approval is a pause during which the world may have
changed. Resuming re-verifies. A checkpointed "approved" is
never sufficient on its own — the durable executor's default
was the opposite, so the rule was written down first.
The chain's enforcers run in the same transaction as the act.
Even a runtime that skips its own checks cannot move value
outside the caveats. This is the residue no off-chain verifier
Intelligence may be probabilistic. Authority must not be.
The planner may be wrong about HOW. It is never consulted about WHETHER.
